knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 3.3.2
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. (1) When do you use a one-sample vs two-sample vs paired test? (2) Name one Normal and one discrete (binomial or Poisson) basic-test setting. (3) Name one reason a permutation test is not today's LO.
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: One-sample tests a single population parameter; two-sample compares independent groups; paired uses matched differences. Normal mean tests and binomial/Poisson tests appear under CMP basic procedures. Permutation is tomorrow's LO.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.
